title: Fourier degree of a junta
statement: Let $h:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{ -1,1\}$ and let $k$ be a natural number. If $h$ depends only on some set of at most $k$ input coordinates, then the Fourier degree of its real-valued sign function is at most $k$.
hypotheses_covered: $h$ maps the sign cube to the two signs
There is a set of at most $k$ coordinates on which $h$ depends
